statement: DualSense player_leds bits 0-4 each switch one of the five player LEDs, with bit 2 the centre LED. Linux and SDL use the same centred player patterns: 0x04, 0x0A, 0x15, 0x1B and 0x1F for players 1-5.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, VIIPER a370903, nondebug 0233835; physical firmware/revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 1714-1735 (centred pattern comment and table), 1222-1245 (one bit per LED); SDL_hidapi_ps5.c 343-365 (same table); nondebug explorer 350-354 (LED1-LED5 map to bits 0-4) and 862-882 (uses 0x04, 0x0A, 0x15, 0x1B). Physical left-to-right order beyond the centre bit is not measured.
